result:
Both gates are green: `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` reports 9 pass / 0 fail.

Posts now carry a `slug` column (`db/schema.ts`, `NOT NULL UNIQUE`) added by the hand-adjusted migration `db/migrations/20260818073258_add_post_slug/migration.sql` — drizzle-kit's generated version would have failed on a populated table, so it now adds the column nullable, backfills existing rows with `post-<id>`, then rebuilds the table with the unique constraint; the sample posts in `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` got explicit slugs. `app/Support/slug.ts` holds `slugify()` (NFD accent folding, lowercase `[a-z0-9]`, single `-` joins, trimmed), and `Post.generateSlug()` in `app/Models/Post.ts` appends the next free `-2`/`-3` suffix via one LIKE query over the slug family; `slug` is deliberately kept out of `Post.fillable` and `PostPayloadSchema`, so retitling a post never rewrites its address. The show route became `GET /posts/:slug` in `routes/web.ts`, and `PostController.show()` resolves an all-digits segment as a legacy id first and answers `301` to `/posts/<slug>` (falling through to a slug lookup, then 404, when no such id exists); `store()` derives the slug and redirects to it, `update()` redirects to the existing slug, and edit/update/destroy stay id-based. `PostResource` now exposes `slug`, and the post list (`route('posts.show', { slug })`) plus the home page's latest posts link to it. Added `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covering slugification, collision numbering, slug stability across a title edit, slug/404 serving, the 301 redirect, and the slug reaching both page payloads, and recorded the reasoning in `docs/adr/0002-address-posts-by-stable-slug.md`.
